func TestProcessorCompletesOnlyAfterCourseAssignment(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	requestRepository := &processorRequestRepository{claimed: planningRequest(now)}
	student := &processorStudentService{profile: testPlanningProfile()}
	course := &processorCourseService{result: domain.EnsureCourseResult{
		CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		Lessons: []domain.CourseLessonBinding{{LessonID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", Order: 0,
			Targets: []domain.TargetRef{{Type: domain.TargetConcept, Key: "go.variables", Version: "v1"}}}},
	}}
	processor := testProcessor(now, requestRepository, student, course)

	processed, err := processor.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("process next: %v", err)
	}
	if !processed || requestRepository.completed == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected completed request")
	}
	if student.assignmentCalls != 1 || student.assignmentRequestID != requestRepository.claimed.ID ||
		student.assignmentKey != requestRepository.claimed.ID {
		t.Fatalf("assignment was not idempotent: %#v", student)
	}
	if course.idempotencyKey != requestRepository.claimed.ID {
		t.Fatalf("course ensure key = %q", course.idempotencyKey)
	}
	if requestRepository.completed.CourseID != course.result.CourseID ||
		requestRepository.completed.ResultCode != domain.CoursePlanResultCreated ||
		requestRepository.completed.LearningPathID != "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected completed request: %#v", requestRepository.completed)
	}
	if student.createCalls != 1 || requestRepository.resolvedLearningPathID != requestRepository.completed.LearningPathID ||
		len(requestRepository.operations) != 2 || requestRepository.operations[0] != "resolve_learning_path" ||
		requestRepository.operations[1] != "complete" {
		t.Fatalf("allocated path was not checkpointed before completion: student=%#v repository=%#v", student, requestRepository)
	}
	if requestRepository.renewCalls < 1 {
		t.Fatal("expected the processor to renew its claim during downstream work")
	}
}

func TestProcessorRetriesAssignmentWithoutCompleting(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	requestRepository := &processorRequestRepository{claimed: planningRequest(now)}
	student := &processorStudentService{profile: testPlanningProfile(), assignmentErr: errors.New("student unavailable")}
	course := &processorCourseService{result: domain.EnsureCourseResult{
		CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		Lessons: []domain.CourseLessonBinding{{LessonID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", Order: 0,
			Targets: []domain.TargetRef{{Type: domain.TargetConcept, Key: "go.variables", Version: "v1"}}}},
	}}
	processor := testProcessor(now, requestRepository, student, course)

	processed, err := processor.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	if !processed || err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected processed retry error, got processed=%v err=%v", processed, err)
	}
	if requestRepository.completed != nil || requestRepository.retried == nil {
		t.Fatal("assignment failure must retry without completing")
	}
	if requestRepository.retryNow != now || requestRepository.retryAt != now.Add(time.Second) {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected retry schedule: now=%v at=%v", requestRepository.retryNow, requestRepository.retryAt)
	}
	if requestRepository.retried.CourseFingerprint == "" || len(requestRepository.retried.NormalizedContextJSON) == 0 {
		t.Fatal("retry did not retain deterministic audit context")
	}
}

func TestProcessorNoGapDoesNotCreateOrAssignCourse(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	requestRepository := &processorRequestRepository{claimed: planningRequest(now)}
	student := &processorStudentService{profile: testPlanningProfile(), allMastered: true}
	course := &processorCourseService{}
	processor := testProcessor(now, requestRepository, student, course)

	processed, err := processor.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	if err != nil || !processed {
		t.Fatalf("process no-gap request: processed=%v err=%v", processed, err)
	}
	if course.calls != 0 || student.assignmentCalls != 0 || student.completionCalls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("no-gap request called downstream mutation: course=%d assignment=%d", course.calls, student.assignmentCalls)
	}
	if requestRepository.completed == nil || requestRepository.completed.ResultCode != domain.CoursePlanResultNoGap ||
		requestRepository.completed.CourseID != "" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected no-gap result: %#v", requestRepository.completed)
	}
}

func TestProcessorNoGapCompletesMatchingCurrentLearningPath(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	request := planningRequest(now)
	request.RequestHash = "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
	request.Intent.Source = domain.PlanningSourceTeacher
	request.Intent.Reason = domain.PlanningReasonInitial
	request.LearningPathID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	requestRepository := &processorRequestRepository{claimed: request}
	student := &processorStudentService{profile: testPlanningProfile(), allMastered: true}
	processor := testProcessor(now, requestRepository, student, &processorCourseService{})

	processed, err := processor.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	if err != nil || !processed {
		t.Fatalf("process no-gap replan: processed=%v err=%v", processed, err)
	}
	if student.planningStateCalls != 1 || student.planningStatePathID != request.LearningPathID ||
		student.completionCalls != 1 || student.completion.LearningPathID != request.LearningPathID ||
		student.completion.ExpectedVersion != 3 ||
		student.completion.CourseFingerprint != "existing-fingerprint" ||
		student.completion.ReasonCode != "mastery_no_gap" || student.completion.Schema != domain.LearningPathNoGapRequestSchema {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected path completion: calls=%d payload=%#v", student.completionCalls, student.completion)
	}
	if requestRepository.checkpointCalls != 1 || requestRepository.completed == nil ||
		requestRepository.completed.LearningPathCommand == nil ||
		requestRepository.completed.LearningPathCommand.Command != domain.LearningPathCommandNoGap {
		t.Fatalf("NO_GAP was not checkpointed and retained: %#v", requestRepository)
	}
}

func TestProcessorRejectsCrossGoalExactPath(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	request := planningRequest(now)
	request.Intent.Reason = domain.PlanningReasonReplan
	request.LearningPathID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	requestRepository := &processorRequestRepository{claimed: request}
	student := &processorStudentService{profile: testPlanningProfile(), allMastered: true}
	student.planningState = processorPlanningState(request.StudentID, request.LearningPathID, "python.backend")
	processor := testProcessor(now, requestRepository, student, &processorCourseService{})

	processed, err := processor.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	if err == nil || !processed || requestRepository.failed == nil {
		t.Fatalf("cross-goal path should fail: processed=%v err=%v failed=%#v", processed, err, requestRepository.failed)
	}
	if student.completionCalls != 0 || student.replanCalls != 0 || student.createCalls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("cross-goal path was mutated: %#v", student)
	}
}

func TestProcessorReplansOnlyRequestedExactPathAndTerminatesKnownConflict(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	request := planningRequest(now)
	request.Intent.Reason = domain.PlanningReasonReplan
	request.LearningPathID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	requestRepository := &processorRequestRepository{claimed: request}
	profile := testPlanningProfile()
	profile.LearningPathCourseID = "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"
	profile.LearningPathGoalCode = "another.selected.path"
	profile.LearningPathRevision = "selected-path-fingerprint"
	profile.LearningPathVersion = 12
	student := &processorStudentService{profile: profile, replanErr: domain.ErrConflict}
	course := &processorCourseService{result: domain.EnsureCourseResult{
		CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		Lessons:  []domain.CourseLessonBinding{{LessonID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", Order: 0}},
	}}
	processor := testProcessor(now, requestRepository, student, course)

	processed, err := processor.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	if !processed || err == nil || requestRepository.failed == nil || requestRepository.retried != nil ||
		requestRepository.completed != nil || requestRepository.failureCode != domain.CoursePlanFailurePathConflict {
		t.Fatalf("stale replan should terminate: processed=%v err=%v repository=%#v", processed, err, requestRepository)
	}
	if student.planningStatePathID != request.LearningPathID || student.replanCalls != 1 ||
		student.replan.LearningPathID != request.LearningPathID || student.replan.ExpectedVersion != 3 ||
		student.createCalls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("replan escaped exact path: %#v", student)
	}
	if requestRepository.failed.LearningPathCommand == nil || requestRepository.checkpointCalls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("terminal conflict lost checkpoint audit: %#v", requestRepository)
	}
	if requestRepository.failed.ResultCode != "" || requestRepository.failed.CourseID != "" || requestRepository.failed.Reused {
		t.Fatalf("terminal conflict exposed an unconfirmed planned outcome: %#v", requestRepository.failed)
	}
	if requestRepository.failed.LearningPathCommand.PlannedCourseID != course.result.CourseID ||
		requestRepository.failed.LearningPathCommand.PlannedResultCode != domain.CoursePlanResultCreated {
		t.Fatalf("terminal conflict lost private planned-outcome audit: %#v", requestRepository.failed.LearningPathCommand)
	}
}

func TestProcessorLostSuccessResponseRetriesIdenticalCheckpointWithoutStateReread(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	request := planningRequest(now)
	request.Intent.Reason = domain.PlanningReasonReplan
	request.LearningPathID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	requestRepository := &processorRequestRepository{claimed: request}
	student := &processorStudentService{
		profile: testPlanningProfile(), replanErrors: []error{errors.New("success response lost"), nil},
	}
	student.replanHook = func(domain.LearningPathReplan) {
		if requestRepository.checkpointed == nil {
			t.Fatal("Student command was sent before durable checkpoint")
		}
	}
	course := &processorCourseService{result: domain.EnsureCourseResult{
		CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		Lessons:  []domain.CourseLessonBinding{{LessonID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", Order: 0}},
	}}
	processor := testProcessor(now, requestRepository, student, course)

	processed, err := processor.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	if !processed || err == nil || requestRepository.retried == nil || requestRepository.checkpointed == nil {
		t.Fatalf("ambiguous first delivery was not checkpointed for retry: processed=%v err=%v repository=%#v", processed, err, requestRepository)
	}
	if requestRepository.retried.ResultCode != "" || requestRepository.retried.CourseID != "" || requestRepository.retried.Reused {
		t.Fatalf("transport ambiguity exposed an unconfirmed planned outcome: %#v", requestRepository.retried)
	}
	if requestRepository.retried.LearningPathCommand == nil ||
		requestRepository.retried.LearningPathCommand.PlannedCourseID != course.result.CourseID {
		t.Fatalf("transport ambiguity lost private planned outcome: %#v", requestRepository.retried)
	}
	firstCheckpoint := *requestRepository.checkpointed
	firstCommand := student.replans[0]
	student.planningState.PathVersion = 99
	requestRepository.retried = nil

	processed, err = processor.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	if !processed || err != nil || requestRepository.completed == nil || student.replanCalls != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("checkpoint replay did not complete: processed=%v err=%v student=%#v repository=%#v", processed, err, student, requestRepository)
	}
	if student.planningStateCalls != 1 || course.calls != 1 || requestRepository.checkpointCalls != 1 ||
		!reflect.DeepEqual(firstCommand, student.replans[1]) ||
		firstCheckpoint.PayloadHash != requestRepository.completed.LearningPathCommand.PayloadHash ||
		requestRepository.completed.LearningPathCommand.ExpectedVersion != firstCommand.ExpectedVersion ||
		requestRepository.completed.ResultCode != domain.CoursePlanResultCreated ||
		requestRepository.completed.CourseID != course.result.CourseID {
		t.Fatalf("retry rebuilt or drifted checkpoint: first=%#v second=%#v student=%#v repository=%#v",
			firstCommand, student.replans[1], student, requestRepository)
	}
}

func TestProcessorDiagnosticCheckpointReplaySkipsDiagnosticProfileGraphAndMasteryReads(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	request := planningRequest(now)
	request.RequestHash = "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
	request.LearningPathID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	request.Intent.Reason = domain.PlanningReasonReplan
	request.ResultCode = domain.CoursePlanResultCreated
	request.CourseID = "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"
	checkpoint, err := domain.NewLearningPathReplanCheckpoint(request, domain.LearningPathReplan{Schema: domain.LearningPathReplanRequestSchema, LearningPathID: request.LearningPathID, PlanningRequestID: request.ID, CourseID: "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888", GoalCode: request.GoalCode, CourseFingerprint: "existing-fingerprint", PlannerPolicyVersion: "course-planner-v1", ReasonCode: "initial_plan", ReasonSummary: "Existing path", ExpectedVersion: 1, Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999", Position: 0, Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "initial_plan"}}}, now)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	request.DiagnosticPlanID = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	request.LearningPathCommand = &checkpoint
	repo := &processorRequestRepository{claimed: request}
	student := &processorStudentService{profile: testPlanningProfile()}
	course := &processorCourseService{}
	diagnostic := &countingDiagnosticRepo{}
	processor := testProcessor(now, repo, student, course)
	processor.DiagnosticPlans = diagnostic
	processor.DiagnosticPlacements = diagnostic
	graphs := &countingGraphRepository{}
	policies := &countingPolicyRepository{}
	processor.Graphs = graphs
	processor.Policies = policies
	processed, err := processor.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	if !processed || err != nil || repo.completed == nil || student.replanCalls != 1 ||
		diagnostic.planCalls != 0 || diagnostic.placementCalls != 0 || student.profileCalls != 0 || student.masteryCalls != 0 ||
		student.planningStateCalls != 0 || graphs.calls != 0 || policies.calls != 0 || course.calls != 0 ||
		student.assignmentCalls != 0 || student.createCalls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("checkpoint reread diagnostic=%#v student=%#v graphs=%#v policies=%#v course=%#v repository=%#v err=%v", diagnostic, student, graphs, policies, course, repo, err)
	}
}

func TestProcessorDiagnosticLinkValidationFailureMatrixHasNoDownstreamMutation(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	studentID := "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"
	planID := "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	valid := diagnosticRecordForCoursePlan(t, studentID, planID)
	placement := diagnosticPlacementForCoursePlan(t, valid.Plan)
	foreign := valid
	foreign.Plan.StudentID = "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb"
	foreign.Plan.PlanDigest, _ = domain.DiagnosticPlanDigest(foreign.Plan)
	corrupt := valid
	corrupt.BindingGoalCode = " Goal "

	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name        string
		plan        domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord
		planErr     error
		placement   domain.DiagnosticPlacementRecord
		placeErr    error
		profile     domain.StudentPlanningProfile
		retry       bool
		readProfile bool
	}{
		{name: "plan not found is terminal", planErr: domain.ErrNotFound},
		{name: "plan transport error retries", planErr: errors.New("planner unavailable"), retry: true},
		{name: "placement not found retries", plan: valid, placeErr: domain.ErrNotFound, retry: true},
		{name: "placement transport error retries", plan: valid, placeErr: errors.New("placement unavailable"), retry: true},
		{name: "foreign plan is terminal", plan: foreign},
		{name: "corrupt private binding is terminal", plan: corrupt},
		{name: "stale onboarding is terminal", plan: valid, placement: placement, profile: diagnosticProfile(2), readProfile: true},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			request := planningRequest(now)
			request.RequestHash = strings.Repeat("a", 64)
			request.Intent.Source = domain.PlanningSourceTeacher
			request.Intent.Reason = domain.PlanningReasonInitial
			request.DiagnosticPlanID = planID
			requests := &processorRequestRepository{claimed: request}
			profile := diagnosticProfile(1)
			if tc.profile.ProfileVersion != "" {
				profile = tc.profile
			}
			student := &processorStudentService{profile: profile}
			course := &processorCourseService{}
			diagnostic := &diagnosticProcessorRepository{plan: tc.plan, planErr: tc.planErr, placement: tc.placement, placementErr: tc.placeErr}
			processor := testProcessor(now, requests, student, course)
			processor.DiagnosticPlans = diagnostic
			processor.DiagnosticPlacements = diagnostic

			processed, err := processor.ProcessNext(context.Background())
			if !processed || err == nil {
				t.Fatalf("processed=%v err=%v", processed, err)
			}
			if tc.retry {
				if requests.retried == nil || requests.failed != nil {
					t.Fatalf("retryable diagnostic dependency was not retried: %#v", requests)
				}
			} else if requests.failed == nil || requests.failureCode != "DIAGNOSTIC_PLAN_INVALID" || requests.retried != nil {
				t.Fatalf("invalid diagnostic link was not terminal: %#v", requests)
			}
			if course.calls != 0 || student.assignmentCalls != 0 || student.createCalls != 0 || student.replanCalls != 0 || student.completionCalls != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("diagnostic rejection mutated downstream: student=%#v course=%#v", student, course)
			}
			if !tc.readProfile && (student.profileCalls != 0 || student.masteryCalls != 0) {
				t.Fatalf("early diagnostic rejection read Student profile/mastery: %#v", student)
			}
		})
	}
}

func diagnosticProfile(onboardingVersion int64) domain.StudentPlanningProfile {
	profile := testPlanningProfile()
	profile.OnboardingVersion = onboardingVersion
	return profile
}

func diagnosticRecordForCoursePlan(t *testing.T, studentID, planID string) domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord {
	t.Helper()
	created := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	binding := domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding{
		GoalCode: "go.backend", DirectionCode: "backend", CourseID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		BindingRevision: 1, PolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticBootstrapPolicyV1, Active: true, CreatedAt: created,
	}
	var err error
	binding.BindingDigest, err = domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBindingDigest(binding)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	plan := domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{
		Schema: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanSchemaV1, ID: planID, StudentID: studentID, CourseID: binding.CourseID,
		PlanRevision: 1, PolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticFixedPolicyV1, CourseRevision: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64),
		OnboardingVersion: 1, BootstrapPolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticBootstrapPolicyV1,
		BootstrapContextDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("c", 64), CreatedAt: created,
	}
	for index := 0; index < 3; index++ {
		plan.Assessments = append(plan.Assessments, domain.DiagnosticAssessment{
			LessonID: fmt.Sprintf("55555555-5555-4555-8555-%012d", index),
			TaskID:   fmt.Sprintf("66666666-6666-4666-8666-%012d", index), TaskVersion: 1,
			UpdatedAt: created, LessonOrder: index,
		})
	}
	plan.PlanDigest, err = domain.DiagnosticPlanDigest(plan)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord{
		IdempotencyKey: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", RequestHash: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("d", 64), Plan: plan,
		BindingRevision: binding.BindingRevision, BindingDigest: binding.BindingDigest, BindingGoalCode: binding.GoalCode,
		BindingDirectionCode: binding.DirectionCode, BindingCreatedAt: binding.CreatedAt,
	}
}

func diagnosticPlacementForCoursePlan(t *testing.T, plan domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan) domain.DiagnosticPlacementRecord {
	t.Helper()
	completed := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 9, 1, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	result := domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult{
		Schema: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResultSchemaV1, StudentID: plan.StudentID, CourseID: plan.CourseID,
		CourseContentRevision: plan.CourseRevision, PolicyVersion: plan.PolicyVersion, AttemptID: plan.ID, PlanID: plan.ID,
		PlanRevision: plan.PlanRevision, Correct: 3, Total: 3, Percent: 100, Band: "ADVANCED",
		BandPolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentBandPolicyV1, PlanDigest: plan.PlanDigest, CompletedAt: completed,
	}
	var err error
	result.ResultDigest, err = domain.DiagnosticResultDigest(result)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	decision := domain.DiagnosticPlacement{
		Schema: domain.DiagnosticPlacementSchemaV1, StudentID: result.StudentID, CourseID: result.CourseID,
		CourseContentRevision: result.CourseContentRevision, PolicyVersion: result.PolicyVersion, AttemptID: result.AttemptID,
		PlanID: result.PlanID, PlanRevision: result.PlanRevision, Correct: result.Correct, Total: result.Total,
		Percent: result.Percent, Band: result.Band, BandPolicyVersion: result.BandPolicyVersion, PlanDigest: result.PlanDigest,
		ResultDigest: result.ResultDigest, ResultCompletedAt: completed, RouteCode: "START_ADVANCED",
		RoutePolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticPlacementRoutePolicyV1, DecidedAt: completed.Add(time.Minute),
	}
	decision.DecisionDigest, err = domain.DiagnosticPlacementDigest(decision)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	hash, err := domain.DiagnosticPlacementConsumeHash(plan.StudentID, plan.ID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return domain.DiagnosticPlacementRecord{RequestID: plan.ID, RequestHash: hash, Decision: decision}
}

type diagnosticProcessorRepository struct {
	plan                      domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord
	planErr                   error
	placement                 domain.DiagnosticPlacementRecord
	placementErr              error
	planCalls, placementCalls int
}

func (r *diagnosticProcessorRepository) GetByStudentKey(context.Context, string, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord, error) {
	return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord{}, domain.ErrNotFound
}
func (r *diagnosticProcessorRepository) GetDiagnosticByID(context.Context, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord, error) {
	r.planCalls++
	return r.plan, r.planErr
}
func (r *diagnosticProcessorRepository) GetLatest(context.Context, string, string, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord, error) {
	return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord{}, domain.ErrNotFound
}
func (r *diagnosticProcessorRepository) Insert(context.Context, domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord, error) {
	return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord{}, errors.New("unused")
}
func (r *diagnosticProcessorRepository) GetDiagnosticPlacement(context.Context, string) (domain.DiagnosticPlacementRecord, error) {
	r.placementCalls++
	return r.placement, r.placementErr
}
func (r *diagnosticProcessorRepository) InsertDiagnosticPlacement(context.Context, domain.DiagnosticPlacementRecord) (domain.DiagnosticPlacementRecord, error) {
	return domain.DiagnosticPlacementRecord{}, errors.New("unused")
}

}
func (r *countingDiagnosticRepo) InsertDiagnosticPlacement(context.Context, domain.DiagnosticPlacementRecord) (domain.DiagnosticPlacementRecord, error) {
	return domain.DiagnosticPlacementRecord{}, errors.New("unused")
}

func TestProcessorCrashAfterDurableCheckpointResumesWithoutRebuilding(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	request := planningRequest(now)
	request.Intent.Reason = domain.PlanningReasonReplan
	request.LearningPathID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	requestRepository := &processorRequestRepository{
		claimed: request, checkpointErr: errors.New("connection lost after commit"), persistCheckpointOnErr: true,
	}
	student := &processorStudentService{profile: testPlanningProfile()}
	course := &processorCourseService{result: domain.EnsureCourseResult{
		CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		Lessons:  []domain.CourseLessonBinding{{LessonID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", Order: 0}},
	}}
	processor := testProcessor(now, requestRepository, student, course)

	processed, err := processor.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	if !processed || err == nil || requestRepository.checkpointed == nil || student.replanCalls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("checkpoint crash boundary was unsafe: processed=%v err=%v student=%#v repository=%#v", processed, err, student, requestRepository)
	}
	requestRepository.checkpointErr = nil
	processed, err = processor.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	if !processed || err != nil || student.replanCalls != 1 || student.planningStateCalls != 1 ||
		course.calls != 1 || requestRepository.checkpointCalls != 1 || requestRepository.completed == nil {
		t.Fatalf("durable checkpoint was rebuilt instead of resumed: processed=%v err=%v student=%#v repository=%#v", processed, err, student, requestRepository)
	}
}

func TestProcessorResolvedInitialRetryUsesExactPathWithoutAllocatingAgain(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	request := planningRequest(now)
	request.LearningPathID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	requestRepository := &processorRequestRepository{claimed: request}
	student := &processorStudentService{profile: testPlanningProfile()}
	course := &processorCourseService{result: domain.EnsureCourseResult{
		CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		Lessons:  []domain.CourseLessonBinding{{LessonID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", Order: 0}},
	}}
	processor := testProcessor(now, requestRepository, student, course)

	processed, err := processor.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	if err != nil || !processed || requestRepository.completed == nil {
		t.Fatalf("resume allocated initial request: processed=%v err=%v", processed, err)
	}
	if student.planningStateCalls != 1 || student.replanCalls != 1 || student.createCalls != 0 ||
		requestRepository.completed.LearningPathID != request.LearningPathID ||
		student.replan.ReasonCode != "initial_plan" {
		t.Fatalf("retry did not resume exact stored path: student=%#v completed=%#v", student, requestRepository.completed)
	}
}

func TestProcessorCrashAfterAllocationResumesSameInitialPathWithoutReasonDrift(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	requestRepository := &processorRequestRepository{
		claimed: planningRequest(now), completeErr: errors.New("terminal write unavailable"),
	}
	student := &processorStudentService{profile: testPlanningProfile()}
	course := &processorCourseService{result: domain.EnsureCourseResult{
		CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		Lessons:  []domain.CourseLessonBinding{{LessonID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", Order: 0}},
	}}
	processor := testProcessor(now, requestRepository, student, course)

	processed, err := processor.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	if !processed || err == nil || student.createCalls != 1 || requestRepository.resolvedLearningPathID == "" {
		t.Fatalf("first attempt did not stop after checkpointed allocation: processed=%v err=%v student=%#v repository=%#v", processed, err, student, requestRepository)
	}
	requestRepository.completeErr = nil
	processed, err = processor.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	if !processed || err != nil || student.createCalls != 2 || student.replanCalls != 0 ||
		student.planningStateCalls != 0 || course.calls != 1 ||
		requestRepository.planningInput.OriginalPath != nil || requestRepository.planningInput.OriginalLearningPathID != "" ||
		student.created.CourseFingerprint != student.planningState.CourseFingerprint ||
		student.created.ReasonCode != "initial_plan" || requestRepository.completed == nil ||
		requestRepository.completed.LearningPathID != requestRepository.resolvedLearningPathID {
		t.Fatalf("retry drifted from allocated initial path: processed=%v err=%v student=%#v repository=%#v", processed, err, student, requestRepository)
	}
}

func TestProcessorStopsImmediatelyWhenClaimRenewalFails(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	requestRepository := &processorRequestRepository{
		claimed: planningRequest(now), renewErr: domain.ErrConflict,
	}
	student := &processorStudentService{profile: testPlanningProfile()}
	processor := testProcessor(now, requestRepository, student, &processorCourseService{})

	processed, err := processor.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	if !processed || !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("lost claim: processed=%v err=%v", processed, err)
	}
	if requestRepository.completed != nil || requestRepository.retried != nil || requestRepository.failed != nil {
		t.Fatal("a worker that lost its claim must not change request state")
	}
	if student.assignmentCalls != 0 || student.completionCalls != 0 {
		t.Fatal("a worker that lost its claim must not mutate Student")
	}
}

func testProcessor(
	now time.Time,
	requests *processorRequestRepository,
	student *processorStudentService,
	course *processorCourseService,
) Processor {
	return Processor{
		Requests: requests, Graphs: processorGraphRepository{}, Policies: processorPolicyRepository{},
		Students: student, Courses: course, IDs: fixedIDs{"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"},
		Generator: processorContentGenerator{},
		Clock:     fixedClock{now}, Strategies: pedagogy.NewDefaultRegistry(), LeaseTTL: 30 * time.Second, MaxAttempts: 5,
	}
}

type processorContentGenerator struct{}

func (processorContentGenerator) GenerateLesson(
	_ context.Context,
	input domainservice.LessonGenerationInput,
	_ string,
) (domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent, error) {
	return domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent{
		DescriptionMarkdown: "Lesson content for " + input.Lesson.Title,
		Examples: []domain.PlannedExample{{
			Title: "Example", DescriptionMarkdown: "Example body", Stacks: []string{"go"},
			TargetConcepts: []string{"go.basics"},
		}},
		KnowledgeChecks: []domain.PlannedTask{{
			Title: "Check", DescriptionMarkdown: "What is the answer?", ExpectedAnswers: []string{"answer"},
		}},
	}, nil
}

func planningRequest(now time.Time) domain.CoursePlanRequest {
	return domain.CoursePlanRequest{
		ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa",
		IdempotencyKey: "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb", RequestHash: strings.Repeat("a", 64), GoalCode: "go.backend",
		Intent: domain.PlanningIntent{Source: domain.PlanningSourceStudent, Reason: domain.PlanningReasonInitial,
			DesiredOutcome: "Go backend"},
		Status: domain.CoursePlanPlanning, Attempts: 1, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now, NextAttemptAt: now,
	}
}

type fixedIDs struct{ value string }

func (ids fixedIDs) NewID() string { return ids.value }

type fixedClock struct{ value time.Time }

func (clock fixedClock) Now() time.Time { return clock.value }

type processorRequestRepository struct {
	claimed                domain.CoursePlanRequest
	completed              *domain.CoursePlanRequest
	retried                *domain.CoursePlanRequest
	failed                 *domain.CoursePlanRequest
	retryAt                time.Time
	retryNow               time.Time
	renewCalls             int
	renewErr               error
	resolvedLearningPathID string
	operations             []string
	completeErr            error
	completeCalls          int
	checkpointed           *domain.LearningPathCommandCheckpoint
	checkpointCalls        int
	checkpointErr          error
	persistCheckpointOnErr bool
	failureCode            string
	loseLeaseAfter         string
	planningInput          *domain.PlanningInputCheckpoint
	generatedCheckpoint    *domain.GeneratedCourseCheckpoint
	ensureCheckpoint       *domain.CourseEnsureCheckpoint
	pinErr                 error
	artifactErr            error
	ensureErr              error
	pinReadErr             error
	artifactReadErr        error
	ensureReadErr          error
	persistPinOnErr        bool
	persistArtifactOnErr   bool
	persistEnsureOnErr     bool
	planningPinCalls       int
	artifactPinCalls       int
	ensurePinCalls         int
}

func (repository *processorRequestRepository) CreateOrGet(
	context.Context,
	domain.CoursePlanRequest,
) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, bool, error) {
	return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, false, errors.New("not implemented")
}

func (repository *processorRequestRepository) GetForStudent(
	context.Context,
	string,
	string,
) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, error) {
	return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, errors.New("not implemented")
}

func (repository *processorRequestRepository) ClaimNext(
	_ context.Context,
	claimToken string,
	_ time.Time,
	_ time.Time,
) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, error) {
	result := repository.claimed
	result.ClaimToken = claimToken
	return result, nil
}

func (repository *processorRequestRepository) RenewClaim(
	_ context.Context,
	_ string,
	_ string,
	_ time.Time,
	_ time.Time,
) error {
	repository.renewCalls++
	return repository.renewErr
}

func (repository *processorRequestRepository) ResolveLearningPath(
	_ context.Context,
	_ string,
	_ string,
	learningPathID string,
	_ time.Time,
) error {
	repository.resolvedLearningPathID = learningPathID
	repository.claimed.LearningPathID = learningPathID
	repository.operations = append(repository.operations, "resolve_learning_path")
	return nil
}

func (repository *processorRequestRepository) CheckpointLearningPathCommand(
	_ context.Context,
	request domain.CoursePlanRequest,
	_ string,
	_ time.Time,
) error {
	repository.checkpointCalls++
	if request.LearningPathCommand == nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if repository.checkpointErr == nil || repository.persistCheckpointOnErr {
		checkpoint := *request.LearningPathCommand
		checkpoint.Payload = append([]byte(nil), checkpoint.Payload...)
		repository.checkpointed = &checkpoint
		repository.claimed = request
		repository.operations = append(repository.operations, "checkpoint_learning_path_command")
	}
	return repository.checkpointErr
}

func (repository *processorRequestRepository) Complete(
	_ context.Context,
	request domain.CoursePlanRequest,
	_ string,
	_ time.Time,
) error {
	repository.completeCalls++
	if repository.completeErr != nil {
		return repository.completeErr
	}
	repository.completed = &request
	repository.operations = append(repository.operations, "complete")
	return nil
}

func (repository *processorRequestRepository) Retry(
	_ context.Context,
	request domain.CoursePlanRequest,
	_ string,
	nextAttemptAt time.Time,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	repository.retried = &request
	repository.claimed = request
	repository.retryAt = nextAttemptAt
	repository.retryNow = now
	return nil
}

func (repository *processorRequestRepository) Fail(
	_ context.Context,
	request domain.CoursePlanRequest,
	_ string,
	failureCode string,
	_ time.Time,
) error {
	repository.failed = &request
	repository.failureCode = failureCode
	repository.operations = append(repository.operations, "fail")
	return nil
}

	return testGoalGraph(), nil
}

type processorPolicyRepository struct{}

func (processorPolicyRepository) GetActivePolicyBundle(context.Context) (domain.PolicyBundle, error) {
	return testPolicyBundle(), nil
}

type processorStudentService struct {
	profile             domain.StudentPlanningProfile
	profileCalls        int
	masteryCalls        int
	allMastered         bool
	assignmentErr       error
	assignmentCalls     int
	assignmentRequestID string
	assignmentKey       string
	completionCalls     int
	completion          domain.LearningPathCompletion
	planningState       domain.LearningPathPlanningState
	planningStateCalls  int
	planningStatePathID string
	createCalls         int
	createErr           error
	created             domain.LearningPathReplacement
	allocation          domain.LearningPathAllocation
	replanCalls         int
	replan              domain.LearningPathReplan
	replanErr           error
	replans             []domain.LearningPathReplan
	replanErrors        []error
	replanHook          func(domain.LearningPathReplan)
}

func (service *processorStudentService) GetPlanningProfile(
	context.Context,
	string,
) (domain.StudentPlanningProfile, error) {
	service.profileCalls++
	return service.profile, nil
}

func (service *processorStudentService) QueryMastery(
	_ context.Context,
	_ string,
	targets []domain.TargetRef,
) ([]domain.TargetMastery, error) {
	service.masteryCalls++
	result := make([]domain.TargetMastery, len(targets))
	for index, target := range targets {
		result[index] = domain.TargetMastery{
			Target: target, State: domain.MasteryUnknown, PolicyVersion: domain.StudentMasteryPolicyVersion,
		}
		if service.allMastered {
			result[index].State = domain.MasteryMastered
			result[index].MasteryScore = 1
			result[index].Confidence = 1
		}
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (service *processorStudentService) AssignCourse(
	_ context.Context,
	_ string,
	_ string,
	planningRequestID string,
	idempotencyKey string,
) error {
	service.assignmentCalls++
	service.assignmentRequestID = planningRequestID
	service.assignmentKey = idempotencyKey
	return service.assignmentErr
}

func (service *processorStudentService) CreateLearningPath(
	_ context.Context,
	studentID string,
	_ string,
	replacement domain.LearningPathReplacement,
) (domain.LearningPathAllocation, error) {
	service.createCalls++
	service.created = replacement
	if service.createErr != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathAllocation{}, service.createErr
	}
	if service.allocation.LearningPathID != "" {
		return service.allocation, nil
	}
	allocation := domain.LearningPathAllocation{
		LearningPathID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", StudentID: studentID,
		CourseID: replacement.CourseID, GoalCode: replacement.GoalCode,
		CourseFingerprint: replacement.CourseFingerprint, PathVersion: 1,
	}
	service.planningState = domain.LearningPathPlanningState{
		Schema: domain.LearningPathPlanningStateSchema, StudentID: studentID, LearningPathID: allocation.LearningPathID,
		CourseID: replacement.CourseID, GoalCode: replacement.GoalCode, CourseFingerprint: replacement.CourseFingerprint,
		Status: "ACTIVE", IsPrimary: true, IsSelected: true, PathVersion: 1, JourneyVersion: 1,
		PlannerPolicyVersion: replacement.PlannerPolicyVersion, ReasonCode: replacement.ReasonCode,
		ReasonSummary: replacement.ReasonSummary, Items: append([]domain.LearningPathItem(nil), replacement.Items...),
		UpdatedAt: time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	}
	return allocation, nil
}

func (service *processorStudentService) GetLearningPathPlanningState(
	_ context.Context,
	studentID string,
	learningPathID string,
) (domain.LearningPathPlanningState, error) {
	service.planningStateCalls++
	service.planningStatePathID = learningPathID
	if service.planningState.LearningPathID != "" {
		return service.planningState, nil
	}
	return processorPlanningState(studentID, learningPathID, "go.backend"), nil
}

func (service *processorStudentService) ReplanLearningPath(
	_ context.Context,
	_ string,
	_ string,
	replan domain.LearningPathReplan,
) (domain.LearningPathCommandResult, error) {
	service.replanCalls++
	service.replan = replan
	service.replans = append(service.replans, replan)
	if service.replanHook != nil {
		service.replanHook(replan)
	}
	if len(service.replanErrors) > 0 {
		err := service.replanErrors[0]
		service.replanErrors = service.replanErrors[1:]
		return domain.LearningPathCommandResult{}, err
	}
	return domain.LearningPathCommandResult{}, service.replanErr
}

func (service *processorStudentService) CompleteLearningPath(
	_ context.Context,
	_ string,
	_ string,
	completion domain.LearningPathCompletion,
) (domain.LearningPathCommandResult, error) {
	service.completionCalls++
	service.completion = completion
	return domain.LearningPathCommandResult{}, nil
}

func processorPlanningState(studentID, learningPathID, goalCode string) domain.LearningPathPlanningState {
	return domain.LearningPathPlanningState{
		Schema: domain.LearningPathPlanningStateSchema, StudentID: studentID, LearningPathID: learningPathID,
		CourseID: "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888", GoalCode: goalCode,
		CourseFingerprint: "existing-fingerprint", Status: "ACTIVE", PathVersion: 3, JourneyVersion: 5,
		PlannerPolicyVersion: "course-planner-v1", ReasonCode: "initial_plan", ReasonSummary: "Existing path",
		Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{{
			ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999",
			Position: 0, Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "first_current_gap",
		}},
		UpdatedAt: time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	}
}

type processorCourseService struct {
	result         domain.EnsureCourseResult
	calls          int
	idempotencyKey string
}

func (service *processorCourseService) EnsureCourse(
	_ context.Context,
	draft domain.GeneratedCourse,
	idempotencyKey string,
) (domain.EnsureCourseResult, error) {
	service.calls++
	service.idempotencyKey = idempotencyKey
	// Model the Course contract: one ordered binding for every ensured lesson.
	var lessons []domain.PlannedLesson
	for _, module := range draft.Modules {
		for _, section := range module.Sections {
			lessons = append(lessons, section.Lessons...)
		}
	}
	for index, lesson := range lessons {
		if index >= len(service.result.Lessons) {
			service.result.Lessons = append(service.result.Lessons, domain.CourseLessonBinding{LessonID: fmt.Sprintf("44444444-4444-4444-8444-%012d", index+1)})
		}
		service.result.Lessons[index].Order = index
		service.result.Lessons[index].Targets = append([]domain.TargetRef(nil), lesson.Targets...)
	}
	return service.result, nil
}

func TestReplanKeepsRepeatedExactRevisionAssignmentsAndDoesNotReuseChangedRevision(t *testing.T) {
	old := []domain.LearningPathItem{
		{LearningPathItemID: "item-a", ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "lesson", LessonRevisionID: "r10"},
		{LearningPathItemID: "item-b", ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "lesson", LessonRevisionID: "r10"},
	}
	desired := []domain.LearningPathItem{
		{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "lesson", LessonRevisionID: "r10"},
		{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "lesson", LessonRevisionID: "r10"},
		{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "lesson", LessonRevisionID: "r11"},
	}
	got := preserveAssignmentIdentities(desired, old)
	if got[0].LearningPathItemID != "item-a" || got[1].LearningPathItemID != "item-b" || got[2].LearningPathItemID != "" {
		t.Fatalf("assignment occurrence/revision mismatch: %#v", got)
	}
}
